requirement: Apply an update-dosage command to an existing model: copy the route of administration, dose text, and CrCl range (including clearing it), refresh UpdatedAt, keep the identity untouched, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The target dosage model is tracked but not yet saved

inputs.text: Turn a standard oral dose into an intravenous adjusted dose with a 15-29 mL/min range
Turn an adjusted oral dose back into the standard dose by clearing the CrCl range

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with no error
Route and dose text are overwritten with the command values
The CrCl range is replaced with all boundary flags intact, and null clears it
UpdatedAt is refreshed and the identity fields are untouched

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
